parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type. Valid values:

- **tcp**: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)

- **udp**: User Datagram Protocol (UDP)

- **icmp**: Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP)

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region for which you want to initiate a task for analyzing network reachability.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source resource.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the source resource. Valid values:

- **ecs**: the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

- **internetIp**: the public IP address

- **vsw**: the vSwitch

- **vpn**: the VPN gateway

- **vbr**: the virtual border router (VBR)

parameters.name: TargetId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination resource.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the destination resource. Valid values:

- **ecs**: the ECS instance

- **internetIp**: the public IP address

- **vsw**: the vSwitch

- **vpn**: the VPN gateway

- **vbr**: the VBR

- **clb**: the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
